## August 30 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 416)

This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 30** across American network radio and wartime news history, two classic frontier tales on *Death Valley Days* written by Ruth Cornwall Woodman for 20 Mule Team Borax (*Yankee Jim* in 1934 and *Bill Stewart's Courtship* in 1940), Paul Rhymer's *Vic and Sade* for Crisco (1939), The Cass County Boys on *10-2-4 Ranch* for Dr Pepper (1945), Mortimer Meek trying to marry off Uncle Louie on *Meet the Meeks* (1947), and a special network pre-emption on *Arch Oboler's Plays* for General MacArthur's landing in Japan (1934–1947):
